title: Spider-Noir — Release
text:
Title: Spider-Noir — Release

Spider-Noir is set to premiere in the United States on MGM+ on May 25, 2026. The series will consist of eight episodes, and will be released globally, 
including in the United States, in its entirety on May 27 on Prime Video. Spider-Noir will be released in both a black-and-white and a fully 
colored version, marketed as "Authentic Black and White" and "True-Hue Full Color", respectively. Cage hoped the dual release would inspire audiences
 to become interested in early black and white noir films to gain an appreciation of them as an art form.
